build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone model with a specified depth like 18, 50, 101, or 152
build_resnetv1d_backbone: build a ResNetV1d backbone with deep stem and avg down sampling enabled
create_basicblock: create a BasicBlock residual unit with two 3x3 convolutions and identity shortcut
create_bottleneck: create a Bottleneck residual unit with 1x1, 3x3, 1x1 convolutions and optional DCN support
review_resnet_forward: review the ResNet forward pass that returns multi-scale feature maps from selected stages
